definitionZh: :不确定 CSS 伪类代表状态不确定的任意形式元素,如已设置为带有 JavaScript 的不确定状态的复选框,属于所有无线电按钮不受限制的组合的无线电按钮,以及没有值属性的进度元素.
sourceDefinition: The :indeterminate CSS pseudo-class represents any form element whose state is indeterminate, such as checkboxes that have been set to an indeterminate state with JavaScript, radio buttons which are members of a group in which all radio buttons are unchecked, and progress elements with no value attribute.
